errors.description: Section 5's 'grid example' is presented as agreeing with the theorem, but for Liu's intervals (7,14,35)/56 the subset-gap is 7/56=1/8, so optimal Xiang play would hold Liu to 9/16, not 4/7; the cited Xiang moves are suboptimal. This is explicitly labelled non-proof material, so it does not affect the argument.
errors.quote:
Sorting gives Liu
\((18+13+1)/56=32/56=4/7\), in agreement with the theorem. This is evidence,
not part of the proof.

errors.description: In the lower-bound graph argument it is used implicitly that the chosen tree component contains no loop (i.e. no rank-pair with both pieces inside one original interval). This follows since a component with a loop has e_C ≥ v_C, but the write-up does not state it.
errors.quote: Loops and parallel edges are allowed.

parsed.notes: Both directions are proved: greedy drafting value (1+D)/2 with a correct induction; the tree/bipartition argument giving D ≥ Γ; the overlay construction giving D ≤ Γ with q−1 cuts; subset-sum pigeonhole and the geometric construction. I checked n=1,2 by hand and all steps verify.
